C1.rule: if the marg arm's globals or per-level statistics differ from logs/exp51_xcorpus.json by >= 1e-9, fix the scaffolding first: no reading from this run may be used and nothing goes into the manuscript until it agrees

C2.rule: `band` may only be called a coverage fix if every MAF-admissible corpus/preparation row has coverage >= 0.85 at its three lowest levels AND global coverage in [0.88, 0.95]; otherwise the word 'fix' is withdrawn and only the reporting duty (per-band coverage vectors beside the marginal number) survives

C3.note: the abstention gate is NOT band-recalibrated (pre-registration I.A changes only the set quantile), so `accept` is arm-invariant by construction and the acceptance-drop limb of C3 cannot fire; the operating cost channel of the band arm is the set size and the empty-set rate, both reported in the same rows
C3.rule: if C2 is achieved but the mean set size inflates > 1.5x, or acceptance drops > 0.10, the coverage was bought with set size / abstention: the method claim retreats to diagnosis and the word 'guarantee' may not appear in a positive sentence

C4.rule: if, after conditioning, the coverage spread across bands with n >= 20 is still > 0.10, the claim downgrades to 'conditioning aligns the band structure but does not guarantee per-band coverage' and the per-band vectors must be given

C5.rule: if MSC lifts the collapsed folds (D1 f4 / D2 f4 / D3 f3 / HONEY f3) to >= 0.80, baseline correction becomes a protocol step and SNV is demoted to 'one of a family'; if they stay < 0.60 the collapse is declared beyond any affine correction and every marginal coverage number must be published with its per-fold vector. Values between 0.60 and 0.80 are not a pre-registered branch and are read conservatively (as not-recovered), never as a success

C6.rule: MSC is supposed to change coverage, not attribution direction. If it drops the pooled-cinnamon whitened top-1 by > 0.05, or pushes the naming MAF to a higher level on any MAF-admissible corpus, MSC does NOT enter the main arm - it stays a contrast column, and the paper must state that the band baseline is not a freely removable nuisance but is aliased with the dose information (same direction as exp45's aliasing audit)

C7.rule: every 'fix/improvement' statement must (a) appear in the same sentence as its cost, (b) be given per corpus and per arm, (c) publish MAF as a euclid/whitening pair, (d) never quote band_oracle in a claim. Rows violating any limb stay out of the tables; anything read off after the run can only enter the limitations section
